response.sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(product_price, 0)) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), o AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall FROM inv) SELECT AVG(avg_cost) AS avg_line_product_cost, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(ratio) - (SELECT overall FROM o) AS ratio_excess_over_overall FROM inv WHERE ratio > (SELECT overall FROM o)

assumptions.assumption: Lines with a zero product_price are treated as having a missing ratio (division by zero yields NULL and is ignored), rather than causing an error.
Invoices whose ratio is NULL (no line with a usable ratio) are left out of the overall average and are not kept, since NULL is not above the average.
The overall average ratio is the unweighted average of per-invoice ratios, as the request states, not a line-level average.
